user.title: Révisions
user.description: Direct address of the Révisions server (IP and port, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8010), not an address going through a proxy, and the token shown in the Révisions parents area (🏠 Home Assistant tab). Home Assistant's IP must also be listed in HA_IPS (revisions.conf).

reauth_confirm.title: Révisions: token update needed
reauth_confirm.description: Révisions ({url}) refuses the current token: a new Révisions version requires it, or it was changed in the parents area. Paste the token from the parents area (🏠 Home Assistant tab).

reconfigure.title: Révisions
reconfigure.description: Direct address of the Révisions server and the token from the parents area.

error.injoignable: Cannot reach this server. Check address and port.
error.pas_revisions: This server answers, but it is not Révisions (or too old: 0.6.0 minimum).
error.jeton: Token refused: copy the one from the Révisions parents area (🏠 Home Assistant tab).
error.ip: Révisions refuses Home Assistant: add its IP to HA_IPS (revisions.conf), then restart Révisions.

abort.already_configured: This Révisions server is already set up.

init.title: Révisions dashboard
init.description: A « Révisions » dashboard in the sidebar: one column per player (today's revisions, break, piggy bank, bonus and penalty buttons), rewards to prepare and the weekly ranking. You can edit it like any dashboard. « Rebuild » updates it after adding a player or a bonus / penalty (and discards your changes). It also exists as a template to paste: the integration's tableau.yaml file.

abort.tableau_impossible: Home Assistant did not allow creating the dashboard (different version?). Use the template to paste: the integration's tableau.yaml file, see the README.
